main_body: vertical repeating wooden fence strip with a continuous left beam and three short posts
top_band: none on the continuous left beam (rows 0-47); light tan 4x4 square tops on the right posts (rows 2-5, 18-21, 34-37)
evidence: This is a 3-tile repeating vertical border strip rather than a standalone open frame. The left beam runs continuously from row 0 to 47 with no top surface, and the repeating right posts lack a distinct front-edge line, eave shadow, or recessed front.

style.evidence: The wood uses a 5-step brown ramp and dark brown outlines with simple checkerboard dithering on the post faces, but it is a narrow repeating tileset border strip that is simpler and less varied than the reference props.
